description: 电子价签模板编辑器 MVP 优化：基于外部传入的 Screen Profile 和模板数据完成可视化编辑、电子墨水屏预览，并在保存时输出 Full JSON、Static PNG Base64 和 Dynamic Metadata。

userStories.title: 支持外部初始化数据契约
userStories.description: As an external business system, I want to initialize the editor with a unified payload so that I can create or edit an ESL template.
acceptanceCriteria: The editor accepts create mode initialization with profile and previewData.
The editor accepts edit mode initialization with templateId, templateName, profile, fullJson, staticDynamic, and previewData.
The editor shows a clear initialization error when mode is missing or not create/edit.
The editor shows a clear initialization error when profile.width or profile.height is missing, non-numeric, or less than or equal to 0.
Use agent-browser to open the editor with valid create initialization data and verify the editor workspace is visible instead of the error view.
Use agent-browser to open the editor with an invalid profile and verify an initialization failure message is visible.
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: 根据 Screen Profile 创建固定尺寸画布
userStories.description: As a template editor user, I want the canvas to use the exact dimensions from the incoming Screen Profile so that the template matches the ESL device.
acceptanceCriteria: The Fabric edit canvas width equals profile.width.
The Fabric edit canvas height equals profile.height.
The preview canvas uses the same width and height as the edit canvas.
The canvas dimensions cannot be changed by editor UI actions after initialization.
The workspace displays the current canvas width and height.
Use agent-browser to open the editor with a 296 x 128 profile and verify both edit and preview canvases render at that aspect ratio.
Use agent-browser to reopen the editor with a different valid profile and verify the displayed canvas dimensions update to the new profile.
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: 支持 BW / BWR / BWRY / E6 颜色模式
userStories.description: As a template editor user, I want colors constrained by the current e-ink color mode so that exported output is compatible with the target device.
acceptanceCriteria: BW profiles expose only black and white palette colors.
BWR profiles expose only black, white, and red palette colors.
BWRY profiles expose only black, white, red, and yellow palette colors.
E6 profiles expose only black, white, red, green, blue, yellow, and orange palette colors.
Color controls for text, line, rectangle, background, price, discount, QR code, and barcode use only colors from profile.palette.
Imported template objects with colors outside profile.palette are snapped to the nearest palette color before preview or save.
Use agent-browser to add a rectangle and verify the color picker only offers the active profile palette colors.
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: 定义系统字段与自定义字段校验
userStories.description: As a template editor user, I want to bind system fields and valid custom text fields so that the template can display business data.
acceptanceCriteria: The reserved system fields are productName, price, discount, description, imageUrl, qrContent, and barcodeContent.
Custom fields support text type only.
Custom field ID validation rejects empty values.
Custom field ID validation rejects values containing characters other than English letters, digits, and underscores.
Custom field ID validation rejects values that do not start with an English letter.
Custom field ID validation rejects values matching reserved system fields.
Custom field ID validation rejects duplicate custom fields within the same template.
Custom field IDs brand, originPrice, memberPrice, and unit pass validation.
Custom field IDs 价格, product-name, 123abc, price, and qrContent show clear validation errors.
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: 支持 RECT 和 LINE 基础组件
userStories.description: As a template editor user, I want to add rectangles and lines so that I can create background blocks, labels, borders, and dividers.
acceptanceCriteria: The toolbar provides an action to add a RECT component.
The toolbar provides an action to add a LINE component.
RECT supports editing x, y, width, height, fill color, stroke color, and stroke width.
LINE supports editing start point, end point, color, and line width.
RECT and LINE color values are constrained to the active profile palette.
Exported Full JSON contains added RECT and LINE objects.
Exported Static PNG Base64 includes the visible RECT and LINE shapes.
Use agent-browser to add one rectangle and one line and verify both are visible on the edit canvas and preview canvas.
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: 支持 TEXT 文本组件
userStories.description: As a template editor user, I want to add fixed or dynamic text so that I can display product names, descriptions, and custom text fields.
acceptanceCriteria: The toolbar provides an action to add a TEXT component.
TEXT can be configured as fixed text without a field binding.
TEXT can bind to productName, description, or a valid custom text field.
TEXT uses the embedded Noto Sans SC Variable font family.
TEXT font weight accepts only normal and bold.
TEXT overflow mode accepts clip, ellipsis, and wrap.
TEXT default overflow mode is ellipsis.
TEXT supports lineClamp.
TEXT supports horizontal alignment and vertical alignment settings.
Use agent-browser to add a TEXT bound to productName, change previewData.productName, and verify the preview displays the new product name.
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: 支持 IMAGE 图片组件
userStories.description: As a template editor user, I want to add static or dynamic images so that templates can display logos, fixed icons, or product images.
acceptanceCriteria: The toolbar provides an action to add a static IMAGE component.
The toolbar provides an action to add a dynamic IMAGE component.
Static IMAGE is rendered into Static PNG Base64 during save.
Dynamic IMAGE is fixed to the imageUrl field.
Dynamic IMAGE is included in dynamicMetadata.widgets during save.
IMAGE fit mode accepts contain, cover, and fill.
IMAGE default fit mode is contain.
IMAGE background color is constrained to the active profile palette.
Use agent-browser to add a dynamic IMAGE with previewData.imageUrl and verify the preview shows the image area.
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: 支持 PRICE 复合价格组件
userStories.description: As a template editor user, I want a dedicated PRICE component so that currency, integer, and decimal parts can be laid out independently.
acceptanceCriteria: The toolbar provides an action to add a PRICE component.
PRICE is fixed to the price field.
PRICE is represented as a dedicated widget and not saved as a plain TEXT component.
PRICE supports currencySymbol with default value ¥.
PRICE supports showCurrency.
PRICE supports decimalPlaces.
PRICE supports thousandSeparator.
PRICE supports decimalSeparator.
PRICE supports separate fontSize, fontWeight, and color for currency, integer, and decimal parts.
PRICE decimal style supports offsetY.
Saved Dynamic Metadata contains the PRICE widget as one item with type PRICE.
Use agent-browser to add PRICE, set previewData.price to 1299.9, and verify the preview displays a formatted price.
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: 支持 DISCOUNT 折扣组件
userStories.description: As a template editor user, I want a DISCOUNT component so that I can create promotion labels quickly.
acceptanceCriteria: The toolbar provides an action to add a DISCOUNT component.
DISCOUNT is fixed to the discount field.
DISCOUNT supports a format template such as {value}折.
DISCOUNT supports background color and text color.
DISCOUNT supports font size and normal/bold font weight.
DISCOUNT supports horizontal center alignment and vertical middle alignment.
DISCOUNT color values are constrained to the active profile palette.
Saved Dynamic Metadata contains the DISCOUNT widget with type DISCOUNT.
Use agent-browser to add DISCOUNT, set previewData.discount to 8.8, and verify the preview displays 8.8折.
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: 支持 QRCODE 二维码组件
userStories.description: As a template editor user, I want to add a QR code component so that ESL templates can display product details or marketing links.
acceptanceCriteria: The toolbar provides an action to add a QRCODE component.
QRCODE is fixed to the qrContent field.
QRCODE does not allow binding to any field other than qrContent.
QRCODE supports width and height settings.
QRCODE supports errorCorrection with default value M.
QRCODE supports margin with default value 1.
QRCODE foregroundColor and backgroundColor are constrained to the active profile palette.
Saved Dynamic Metadata contains the QRCODE widget with type QRCODE.
Use agent-browser to add QRCODE, set previewData.qrContent to a URL, and verify the preview displays a QR code graphic.
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: 支持 BARCODE 条形码组件
userStories.description: As a template editor user, I want to add a CODE128 barcode component so that ESL templates can display product codes.
acceptanceCriteria: The toolbar provides an action to add a BARCODE component.
BARCODE is fixed to the barcodeContent field.
BARCODE does not allow binding to any field other than barcodeContent.
BARCODE supports CODE128 only.
BARCODE does not show EAN-13, UPC-A, DataMatrix, or other barcode format options.
BARCODE supports showText.
BARCODE foregroundColor and backgroundColor are constrained to the active profile palette.
Saved Dynamic Metadata contains the BARCODE widget with type BARCODE.
Use agent-browser to add BARCODE, set previewData.barcodeContent to SKU1001, and verify the preview displays a CODE128 barcode.
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: 支持电子墨水屏预览
userStories.description: As a template editor user, I want a live e-ink preview so that I can confirm the approximate final device output.
acceptanceCriteria: The editor page displays both an edit canvas and a preview canvas.
The preview canvas updates after an object is added, modified, or deleted on the edit canvas.
The preview renderer quantizes output colors to the active profile palette.
BW preview output contains only black and white colors.
BWR preview output contains only black, white, and red colors.
BWRY preview output contains only black, white, red, and yellow colors.
E6 preview output contains only black, white, red, green, blue, yellow, and orange colors.
Use agent-browser to change an object color and verify the preview updates to the palette-constrained result.
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: 生成保存 Payload
userStories.description: As an external business system, I want the editor to produce a complete template payload on save so that the host system can persist or process it.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking save generates templateId.
Clicking save generates templateName.
Clicking save includes the complete profile object.
Clicking save includes fullJson.
Clicking save includes staticDynamic.staticImage.
staticDynamic.staticImage.type equals base64.
staticDynamic.staticImage.format equals png.
staticDynamic.staticImage.data starts with data:image/png;base64,.
Clicking save includes staticDynamic.dynamicMetadata.
dynamicMetadata.fontFamily equals Noto Sans SC Variable.
dynamicMetadata.reservedFields contains all reserved system fields.
dynamicMetadata.widgets contains every dynamic widget on the template.
Use agent-browser to add TEXT, PRICE, IMAGE, and QRCODE widgets, click save, and verify the emitted payload contains matching widgets.
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: 支持 onSave 优先保存方式
userStories.description: As an external business system, I want to receive the save payload through onSave so that the host system owns persistence.
acceptanceCriteria: When onSave is provided, clicking save calls onSave(payload).
The payload passed to onSave matches the save payload structure.
The page shows a clear success state after onSave resolves successfully.
The page shows a clear failure message after onSave rejects or throws.
When both onSave and saveApi are provided, the editor does not send a saveApi request.
Use agent-browser to click save with an onSave test callback and verify the callback is called exactly once.
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: 支持 saveApi 兼容保存方式
userStories.description: As an external business system, I want the editor to call a configured saveApi when onSave is not provided so that simple integration still works.
acceptanceCriteria: When onSave is not provided and saveApi is provided, clicking save sends a POST request to saveApi.
The POST request body equals the save payload.
The page shows a clear success state when saveApi returns a 2xx response.
The page shows a clear failure message when saveApi returns a non-2xx response or a network error.
When neither onSave nor saveApi is provided, clicking save shows a clear save configuration error.
In the local development environment, the save request reaches the configured backend endpoint and is not handled as a Vite frontend fallback or 404.
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: 完成创建到保存的闭环验证
userStories.description: As a template editor user, I want to complete the full flow from initialization to editing, preview, and save so that MVP functionality is verified end to end.
acceptanceCriteria: Use agent-browser to open the editor in create mode with a BWR profile and complete previewData.
Use agent-browser to add RECT, TEXT, PRICE, DISCOUNT, dynamic IMAGE, QRCODE, and BARCODE components.
The edit canvas visibly contains every added component.
The preview canvas visibly contains the palette-quantized result.
Clicking save generates Full JSON.
Clicking save generates Static PNG Base64.
Clicking save generates Dynamic Metadata.
Dynamic Metadata contains TEXT, PRICE, DISCOUNT, IMAGE, QRCODE, and BARCODE widgets.
The browser console has no errors during the full flow.
Typecheck passes
